# Pull Request Template Selector

GitHub does not support interactive buttons in PR templates, but these links can reload the current PR page with a selected template.

> If links are not clickable in **Write** mode, switch to **Preview** and click one link below.

- [Load Feature / Bugfix template](?template=feature_bugfix.md)
- [Load RC / Hotfix template](?template=rc_hotfix.md)
- [Load Epic template](?template=epic.md)

---

## Quick start (required)

- [ ] PR is Draft while work is in progress
- [ ] Correct specialized template has been applied
- [ ] Scope is focused and reviewer-ready
